paragraphs.en: Used by some of the world's largest companies, Next.js enables you to create full-stack web applications by extending the latest React features, and integrating powerful Rust-based JavaScript tooling for the fastest builds.
paragraphs.zh: Next.js 已被全球一些最大的公司使用，它通过扩展最新的 React 特性，并集成强大的基于 Rust 的 JavaScript 工具链，让您能够创建全栈 Web 应用程序，实现最快的构建速度。

paragraphs.en: Visit https://nextjs.org/docs to view the full documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 访问 https://nextjs.org/docs 查看完整文档。

paragraphs.en: The Next.js community can be found on GitHub Discussions where you can ask questions, voice ideas, and share your projects with other people.
paragraphs.zh: Next.js 社区位于 GitHub Discussions，你可以在那里提问、发表想法，并与其他人分享你的项目。

paragraphs.en: To chat with other community members, you can join the Next.js Discord server.
paragraphs.zh: 要与其他社区成员聊天，你可以加入 Next.js 的 Discord 服务器。

paragraphs.en: Do note that our Code of Conduct applies to all Next.js community channels. Users are highly encouraged to read and adhere to it to avoid repercussions.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，我们的行为准则适用于所有 Next.js 社区渠道。 强烈建议用户阅读并遵守该准则，以避免产生不良后果。

paragraphs.en: Contributions to Next.js are welcome and highly appreciated. However, before you jump right into it, we would like you to review our Contribution Guidelines to make sure you have a smooth experience contributing to Next.js.
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎并为 Next.js 做出贡献，我们对此深表感谢。 不过，在您着手开始之前，我们希望您先阅读我们的贡献指南（Contribution Guidelines），以确保您在为 Next.js 做贡献的过程中拥有顺畅的体验。

paragraphs.en: We have a list of good first issues that contain bugs that have a relatively limited scope. This is a great place for newcomers and beginners alike to get started, gain experience, and get familiar with our contribution process.
paragraphs.zh: 我们有一份「新手友好」议题列表，其中包含范围相对有限的缺陷。 无论是新手还是初学者，这里都是一个绝佳的起点，可以积累经验并熟悉我们的贡献流程。

paragraphs.en: If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Next.js, we encourage you to responsibly disclose this and NOT open a public issue .
paragraphs.zh: 如果您认为您在 Next.js 中发现了安全漏洞，我们鼓励您负责任地进行披露，而不要创建公开的 issue。

paragraphs.en: To participate in our Open Source Software Bug Bounty program, please visit https://hackerone.com/vercel .
paragraphs.zh: 要参与我们的开源软件漏洞赏金计划，请访问 https://hackerone.com/vercel 。
